title: Source Registry
description: Schema for config/sources.yaml — the single source of truth for data sources (v0.2 §8.2, PRD §20). Top level is an array of source entries. SECURITY CONTRACT: the credentials field declares only the NAMES of required credentials (e.g. 'github_token'). Real secrets must never appear here — they live in host credential storage. additionalProperties=false makes accidental secret leakage into an entry schema-invalid.

name.description: Unique source identifier used across plans/evidence/ reports (e.g. reddit, host_web_search).

type.description: Evidence-role class (v0.2 §8.1): web=host search,  official=first-party, community=T2, marketplace=T3,  secondary=T4.

items.description: Credential NAME only — standard environment-variable name (POSIX shell). Secret-shaped values (containing '=', spaces, leading digits, or other embedded special characters) are rejected at schema validation.

credentials.description: Names of credentials this source needs. Empty/absent = no auth needed. Real values live in host secret storage.

priority.description: Fan-out priority (higher = preferred). Absent = default  registry order.
